intro.text: A race of sapient spren that live mostly in the Cognitive Realm.

description.text: Inkspren dislike humans as irrational and changeable, and admire those who are cautious, logical and unemotional. Their society opposes refounding the Knights Radiant, believing death is the only outcome for a bonded spren; very few will try the bond again.

Unlike other sapient spren, they cannot change shape or turn invisible in the Physical Realm, but they can change their size drastically, from that of a person down to a speck of dust, and can blend into shadows.

In the Cognitive Realm inkspren are humanlike and never change shape. They are angular, like unfinished statues, wholly black with a marble-like sheen that shimmers in many colours, as if oiled. Their stiff, fashionable clothes and carapace-like armour are part of them, and some carry swords.
They are very common in Shadesmar cities such as Celebrant.
They speak in a particular way, saying simply that something "is" rather than that it is here or exists, and keep their body language spare.
